epokit-common settings for my-lib.
#
# A JavaScript/TypeScript project keeps its version in package.json; the
# vendored tooling at scripts/repokit-common/ treats the plain VERSION file as
# the source and package.json (and any other manifest a layer adds) as a
# target it keeps in step, so one bump moves every copy. `repokit create`
# adds the product's `languages` below (typescript with the ts layer, else
# javascript); the hooks' detection from the root (package.json, tsconfig.json)
# is only their fallback, and it cannot see a plugin's markers in plugin/.

[tool.repokit-common]
version-source = "VERSION"
changelog = "CHANGELOG.md"
repo-url = "https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/my-lib"
tag-prefix = "v"
private-patterns = ["private/", "local/", ".env"]
# What a push runs: npm test, once the dependencies are installed (a fresh
# create has none, and a TypeScript test needs tsc). Without this the hook's
# default test step looks for Python tests and runs nothing here.
test-command = "if [ -d node_modules ] || ! grep -q devDependencies package.json; then npm test; else echo dependencies not installed: run npm install and the push will run npm test; fi"

# package.json carries the same version; the version tool keeps it in step.
[[tool.repokit-common.extra-targets]]
path = "package.json"
type = "json"
field = "version"
'
